chapter: Learning violin and banjo in New Orleans
title: Rampart Street dance halls: Bulls Club, San Souci Hall and neighbourhood bands
summary: His father takes him to hear bands at the Bulls Club and San Souci Hall; he recalls Kid Rena's band, Jack Carey's band, Zutty Singleton, torchlight parades and Holy Ghost church dances.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
